in_sanskrit.name: Tajmul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Crown, adornment, victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tajmul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Tajmul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Taj' which means crown or adornment. The suffix 'mul' denotes victory. This name is often given to a baby boy who is believed to be a victor, a conqueror, or someone who will be adorned with success and prosperity throughout his life.
